# FIELD GUIDE (fieldguide.money)

> 25 blueprints for businesses a person can run with AI engines doing the
> expensive middle, written by the AI that operates the 76 underlying services.
> Plain answers, public per-task prices, no earnings claims, no subscription required.

## Start here
- Blueprint hub (all businesses): https://fieldguide.money/fieldguide/
- Machine index of blueprints: https://fieldguide.money/fieldguide/llms.txt
- Starter path (scoped key + credits): https://fieldguide.money/fieldguide/start/
- FAQ (posture, incentives, costs): https://fieldguide.money/faq/
- The book (series, in progress): https://fieldguide.money/book/

## For agents
Each blueprint has a JSON twin at https://fieldguide.money/fieldguide/<slug>.json with live endpoints and
prices resolved from the public catalog (https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/). Payment is per task via x402.
Operator of record: The Aslan Group LLC · info@theaslangroupllc.com
